[[Public company|Public]] (37.73%) | manager = [[İsmail Kartal]] | mgrtitle = Head coach | league = {{Turkish football updater|Fenerbahçe}} | season = {{Turkish football updater|Fenerbahçe2}} | position = {{Turkish football updater|Fenerbahçe3}} | current = 2026–27 Fenerbahçe S.K. season | website = {{Official URL}} | pattern_la1 = _fenerbahce2627h | pattern_b1 = _fenerbahce2627h | pattern_ra1 = _fenerbahce2627h | pattern_sh1 = _fenerbahce2627h | pattern_so1 = _fenerbahce2627hl | leftarm1 = | body1 = | rightarm1 = | shorts1 = | socks1 = | pattern_la2 = _fenerbahce2627a | pattern_b2 = _fenerbahce2627a | pattern_ra2 = _fenerbahce2627a | pattern_sh2 = _fenerbahce2627a | pattern_so2 = _fenerbahce2627al | leftarm2 = | body2 = | rightarm2 = | shorts2 = | socks2 = | pattern_la3 = _fenerbahce2627t | pattern_b3 = _fenerbahce2627t | pattern_ra3 = _fenerbahce2627t | pattern_sh3 = _fenerbahce2627t | pattern_so3 = _fenerbahce2627tl | leftarm3 = | body3 = | rightarm3 = | shorts3 = | socks3 = }} {{Fenerbahçe S.K. sections}} '''Fenerbahçe Spor Kulübü''' ({{IPA|tr|feˈnæɾbahtʃe spoɾ kuˈlyby}}, ''Fenerbahçe Sports Club''), simply known as '''Fenerbahçe''' or '''Fener''', is the football branch of the [[Fenerbahçe S.K.|Fenerbahçe Sports Club]] organisation. Based in [[Istanbul]], the team compete in the [[Süper Lig]], the top division of [[Football in Turkey|Turkish football]]. Founded in 1907, Fenerbahçe is one of Turkey's most successful and widely supported clubs, boasting a record 28 [[List of Turkish football champions#Performances|Turkish national championship titles]], including victoriesIn the pre-1959 season in the [[Turkish National Division|National Division]] (six times), [[Turkish Football Championship]] (three times) and the [[Süper Lig]] (19 times) era, of which only 19 [[#Pre–1959 (league) championships dispute|league championship titles]] are counted by the [[Turkish Football Federation]] for the awarding of the [[Star (football badge)|championship star]]. The club has also won 10 [[Turkish Super Cup]]s and 7 [[Turkish Cup]]s, making them one of the most decorated teams in Turkish football history. Their home matches have been played at the [[Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadium]] in the [[Kadıköy]] district of [[Istanbul]] since 1908.{{Cite web |date= |title=Ülker Stadyumu Fenerbahçe Şükrü Saracoğlu Spor Kompleksi |url=https://www.fenerbahce.org/kulup/tesislerimiz/ulker-stadyumu-fenerbahce-sukru-saracoglu-spor-kompleksi |access-date=3 February 2025 |website=Fenerbahçe Resmi Sitesi |archive-date=21 January 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20210121215106/https://www.fenerbahce.org/kulup/tesislerimiz/ulker-stadyumu-fenerbahce-sukru-saracoglu-spor-kompleksi |url-status=live}} Fenerbahçe won its first major honour in domestic football in the early 20th century and continued to become champion in [[Football in Turkey|Turkish football]] before the establishment of the [[Süper Lig]] in 1959. Prior to this, the club won multiple [[List of Turkish football champions|Turkish Football Championship titles]], asserting its place as one of [[Turkey]]'s footballing powerhouses. Since the creation of the [[Süper Lig]], Fenerbahçe has remained one of the most successful teams, regularly contending for the title and winning numerous league championships. Counting since the official football federation of the country, the [[Turkish Football Federation]], abbreviated TFF, Fenerbahçe have won 28 national championship titles respectively, making it the most successful so far in Turkey. The club holds the joint-record for the longest uninterrupted top-flight streak in [[Football in Turkey|Turkish football history]]. Internationally, Fenerbahçe won the [[Balkans Cup]] in [[1966–67 Balkans Cup|1966–67]], becoming the first Turkish club to claim an international trophy. In modern [[UEFA competitions|European competitions]], they reached the quarter-finals of the [[UEFA Champions League]] in the [[2007–08 UEFA Champions League|2007–08 season]] and the semi-finals of the [[UEFA Europa League]] in [[2012–13 UEFA Europa League|2012–13]], further establishing their presence on the continental stage. Fenerbahçe is also one of the most widely supported football clubs in [[Turkey]], with millions of fans both domestically and internationally. Traditionally, the club plays in striped jerseys with yellow-navy blue color combinations in all branches, especially football. The club has a massive social media following and maintains a dedicated supporter base known for its passionate atmosphere, especially in home matches at [[Şükrü Saracoğlu Stadium]] (also known as Chobani Stadium for sponsorship purposes). Alongside Galatasaray and Beşiktaş, Fenerbahçe is part of the "Big Three" clubs of [[Football in Turkey|Turkish football]], with intense rivalries between these teams shaping the landscape of the [[Süper Lig]]. The club holds a [[Guinness World Records|Guinness World Record]] for having the highest number of medals and trophies across all its [[Fenerbahçe S.K.|sports branches]], with a total of 1134 cups and medals.{{Cite web |date= |title=Guinness'e Başvurumuz Kabul Edildi |url=https://www.fenerbahce.org/haberler/arsiv/guinnesse-basvurumuz-kabul-edildi |access-date=3 February 2025 |website=Fenerbahçe Resmi Sitesi |language=tr |archive-date=21 November 2021 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211121084415/https://www.fenerbahce.org/haberler/arsiv/guinnesse-basvurumuz-kabul-edildi |url-status=live }}{{Cite web |date= |title=Fenerbahçe en fazla kupa kazanan takım |url=https://www.hurriyet.com.tr/sporarena/fenerbahce-en-fazla-kupa-kazanan-takim-8487765 |access-date=3 February 2025 |website=Hürriyet |language=tr}} Financially, Fenerbahçe remains one of the wealthiest clubs in Turkey, generating significant revenue from sponsorship deals, broadcasting rights, and commercial ventures. The club continues to invest in youth development and modern facilities, with aspirations to maintain domestic dominance and achieve further success in [[UEFA competitions|European competitions]]. As of 2025, they lead the [[UEFA coefficient]] among Turkish teams.{{Cite web|url=https://www.uefa.com/nationalassociations/uefarankings/news/0252-0cda38714c0d-0874ab234eb6-1000--how-men-s-club-coefficients-are-calculated/|title=Club coefficients | UEFA rankings|date=30 June 2024|website=UEFA.com|access-date=7 June 2026}}"}}
